book.name: Momentum, twenty day
book.rule: Buy the twenty-day high, out after twelve sessions.

book.name: Momentum, forty day
book.rule: Buy the forty-day high, out after twenty-two sessions.

book.name: Trend, dual average
book.rule: Long while the fast average is above the slow one.

book.name: Trend, dual average, slower
book.rule: The same, with both averages doubled in length.

book.name: Carry, rates
book.rule: Hold the steeper end of the curve against the flatter.

book.name: Carry, currencies
book.rule: Long the higher-yielding currency against the lower.

book.name: Short volatility, index
book.rule: Sell the front-month straddle and delta hedge.

book.name: Credit spread
book.rule: Long high yield against duration-matched government bonds.

book.name: Mean reversion, intraday
book.rule: Fade the first hour move, flat by the close.

book.name: Pairs, sector neutral
book.rule: Long the cheaper of a matched pair, short the dearer.

book.name: Seasonal, energy
book.rule: Long into the seasonal build, out before the draw.

book.name: Event, index rebalance
book.rule: Trade the flow around a scheduled index change.

context.marketContext: Three years of daily results. The period contains one stress window of about forty sessions, roughly two thirds of the way through, when most risk assets fell together.
context.howToRead: Each series is that strategy’s daily result in basis points of the capital allocated to it, one number per trading day in order. Every statistic about the two series together has been left out on purpose.
context.note: Twelve invented strategies with invented results. No correlation, covariance or summary statistic is in the state: reading the two series is the task.
